memory_note: All rounds use sampled process-tree PSS.

definitions.range: Median and observed min/max of three independent repeats; no confidence interval.
definitions.success_rps: Successful completions inside the measurement window / window seconds.
definitions.p99_ms: Per-run P99 from scheduled time to complete response body; all completed requests; dropped requests have no latency sample.
definitions.cpu_ms_per_success: Application process tree including Nginx CPU milliseconds during the full load invocation / successful completions including drain.
definitions.peak_memory_mib: Maximum sampled application process-tree memory including Nginx; startup before measurement is excluded.
definitions.error_percent: Each outcome count / (planned + not_scheduled); categories remain separate.
definitions.cache_hit_percent: cache_hits / (cache_hits + cache_misses); null means no cache-bearing responses.
